name: Garland Sunday

attributes.attribute: a name for the festival of Lughnasa
also called Garden Sunday and Garlic Sunday
falls on the first Sunday of August

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Garland Sunday is another name for a Celtic festival. Garden Sunday and Garlic Sunday are related names. The day is the first Sunday of August. It is the festival of Lughnasa on that date. The festival is named for the god Lugh. See Lughnasa for the full account.

okr.objective: Record Garland Sunday as an alternate name for the festival of Lughnasa.
key_results: Garland Sunday was a name for the festival of Lughnasa.
The day fell on the first Sunday of August.
The festival was named for the god Lugh.
